name: lang-assembly
description: Use when the user asks about assembly, x86-64 or AArch64 code, calling conventions, System V or Windows x64 ABI, reading disassembly, objdump, Compiler Explorer, inline asm or stack frames. Produces annotated assembly and small hand-written routines. Not for microarchitecture tuning (use cpu-architecture) or compiler implementation (use compiler-design).
